title: Accurate Gauge-Invariant Tensor Network Simulations for Abelian Lattice Gauge Theory in (2+1)D: ground state and real-time dynamics
venue: arxiv (cond-mat, hep-lat), submitted Mar 2025, revised Aug 2025
abstract_summary: Introduces gauge-canonical tensor network states for accurate simulation of Z2, Z3, Z4 gauge theories in (2+1)D on lattices up to 32x32. First VMC-based real-time dynamics of PEPS. Accurate ground state and dynamics for Z2 theory with hard-core bosons.
relevance_reason: Z2 gauge theory tensor network methods are directly relevant to our ALM+projection Z2 symmetry work. The gauge-canonical form provides a more principled approach than our current projection method.
connection_to_project: Our ALM+projection method enforces Z2 symmetry via an augmented Lagrangian; this paper's gauge-canonical form may offer superior convergence. Relevant to SIM-2026-013 and our 3.33% energy floor mystery.
